verses.en: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.pt: Bendito seja o SENHOR, rocha minha, que ensina minhas mãos para a batalha, e meus dedos para a guerra.
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> Praise be to the God of my strength, teaching my hands the use of the sword, and my fingers the art of fighting:

verses.en: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.pt: Ele é minha bondade e meu castelo; meu alto refúgio, e meu libertador; ele é meu escudo, em quem confio; e aquele que faz meu povo se submeter a mim.
verses.en_web: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge; who subdues my people under me.
verses.en_bbe: He is my strength, and my Rock; my high tower, and my saviour; my keeper and my hope: he gives me authority over my people.

verses.en: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR, o que é o homem para que lhe dês atenção? E o filho do homem, para que com ele te importes?
verses.en_web: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
verses.en_bbe: Lord, what is man, that you keep him in mind? or the son of man that you take him into account?

verses.en: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.pt: O homem é semelhante a um sopro; seus dias, como a sombra que passa.
verses.en_web: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
verses.en_bbe: Man is like a breath: his life is like a shade which is quickly gone.

verses.en: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR, abaixa teus céus, e desce; toca os montes, e fumeguem.
verses.en_web: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
verses.en_bbe: Come down, O Lord, from your heavens: at your touch let the mountains give out smoke.

verses.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.pt: Lança relâmpagos, e os dispersa; envia tuas flechas, e os derrota.
verses.en_web: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
verses.en_bbe: With your storm-flames send them in flight: send out your arrows for their destruction.

verses.en: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.pt: Estende tuas mãos desde o alto; livra-me, e resgata-me das muitas águas, das mãos dos filhos de estrangeiros;
verses.en_web: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners;
verses.en_bbe: Put out your hand from on high; make me free, take me safely out of the great waters, and out of the hands of strange men;

verses.en: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.pt: Cuja boca fala coisas inúteis, e sua mão direita é a mão direita da mentira.
verses.en_web: whose mouths speak deceit, Whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.en_bbe: In whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.

verses.en: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, a ti cantarei uma canção nova; com harpa e instrumento de dez cordas tocarei música a ti.
verses.en_web: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
verses.en_bbe: I will make a new song to you, O God; I will make melody to you on an instrument of ten cords.

verses.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.pt: Tu és o que dás vitória aos reis, e livras a Davi, teu servo, da espada maligna.
verses.en_web: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
verses.en_bbe: It is God who gives salvation to kings; and who kept his servant David from the wounding sword.

verses.en: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.pt: Livra-me e resgata-me das mãos dos filhos de estrangeiros; cuja boca fala mentiras, e sua mão direita é mão direita de falsidade.
verses.en_web: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.en_bbe: Make me free, and take me out of the hands of strange men, in whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.

verses.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.pt: Para que nossos filhos sejam como plantas, que crescem em sua juventude; e nossas filhas sejam como esquinas entalhadas ao modo do palácio.
verses.en_web: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
verses.en_bbe: Our sons are like tall young plants; and our daughters like the shining stones of a king's house;

verses.en: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.pt: Nossos celeiros sejam cheios de todos os tipos de mantimentos; nosso gado seja aos milhares, e dezenas de milhares em nossos campos.
verses.en_web: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
verses.en_bbe: Our store-houses are full of all good things; and our sheep give birth to thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

verses.en: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.pt: Nossos bois sejam vigorosos; não haja nem assalto, nem fugas, nem gritos em nossas ruas.
verses.en_web: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
verses.en_bbe: Our oxen are well weighted down; our cows give birth safely; there is no going out, and there is no cry of sorrow in our open places.

verses.en: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado é o povo que assim lhe acontece; bem-aventurado é o povo cujo Deus é o SENHOR! Cântico de Davi:
verses.en_web: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the nation whose ways are so ordered: yes, happy is the nation whose God is the Lord.
